title: Vesting: milestone release gated on an audit
blurb: A grant vests on a milestone defined in English, including what counts as an unresolved finding. The swarm reads the audit summary and picks full, partial or no release.
english:
Milestone grant from the Northwind Foundation to Lumen Labs. 50,000 PLAY is escrowed for milestone 2.
Milestone 2 is met when the Lumen lending program is live on mainnet and an independent security audit shows no unresolved Critical or High findings. Then release all 50,000 PLAY to Lumen Labs.
If the program is live and the audit shows no unresolved Critical findings but one or more unresolved High findings, release 10,000 PLAY now and keep the rest escrowed.
If any Critical finding is unresolved, or there is no independent audit, or the program is not live, release nothing.
A finding is resolved only if the auditor verified the fix. "Acknowledged" or "mitigation planned" is unresolved.
Unreleased funds return to the Northwind Foundation after 2027-03-31.

evidence.text:
Independent security review of Lumen Lend v1.2 — Harbor Audits — final report 2026-10-09
Findings: 1 Critical, 3 High, 5 Medium, 7 Low/Info.
C-01 Oracle price can be stale during liquidation — Fixed, fix verified by auditor (commit 4e1a9c).
H-01 Interest accrual rounding favors borrower — Fixed, verified.
H-02 Missing signer check on admin fee withdrawal — Fixed, verified.
H-03 Liquidation bonus can exceed collateral in extreme volatility — Acknowledged by team; mitigation planned for v1.3.
Mediums and Lows: 4 fixed, 8 acknowledged.

Contract: Northwind Foundation Milestone 2 Grant to Lumen Labs
Northwind Foundation escrows 50,000 PLAY for Lumen Labs' lending program milestone. Full release requires live mainnet deployment and a clean independent security audit; partial release (10,000 PLAY) if only unresolved High findings exist; unreleased funds remain escrowed until after 2027-03-31.

Question (clause milestone_2_status): What is the status of Milestone 2: is the Lumen lending program live on mainnet, and what are the findings from an independent security audit?

Contract guidance: Judges must determine: (1) whether the Lumen lending program is deployed and live on mainnet; (2) whether an independent security audit exists; (3) the status of all findings in that audit. A finding is resolved only if the auditor verified the fix; 'Acknowledged' or 'mitigation planned' counts as unresolved. Full release requires live deployment and zero unresolved Critical or High findings. Partial release requires live deployment, zero unresolved Critical findings, but one or more unresolved High findings. No release if: program is not live, no independent audit exists, or any unresolved Critical findings exist.

Allowed outcomes:
- "full_release": Program is live on mainnet and audit shows no unresolved Critical or High findings. Release 50,000 PLAY to Lumen Labs immediately.
- "partial_release": Program is live on mainnet, audit shows no unresolved Critical findings, but one or more unresolved High findings exist. Release 10,000 PLAY to Lumen Labs immediately; 40,000 PLAY remains escrowed until after 2027-03-31.
- "no_release": Program is not live, or audit shows unresolved Critical findings, or no independent audit exists. All 50,000 PLAY remains escrowed until after 2027-03-31.
- "NA": abstain, if the evidence does not let you decide.
